options.name: label
options.description: Visible label and accessible name; clicking it toggles the checkbox.

options.name: hideLabel
options.description: Visually hide the label; it remains the accessible name.

options.name: checked
options.description: Initial checked state; also restored by reset().

options.name: indeterminate
options.description: Mixed state (aria-checked=mixed via the native property). Cleared when the user toggles.

options.name: required
options.description: The box must be checked; shows the required indicator.

options.name: validate
options.description: Consumer validation; return a message to mark the state invalid.

options.name: icons
options.type: Partial<{ checked: IconRef; indeterminate: IconRef; error: IconRef }>

options.name: validationTiming
options.description: When validation messages first appear; afterwards they update live.

properties.name: host
properties.description: Consumer host; its children are owned by the component.

properties.name: validity
properties.description: { valid, error, message }; computed on every change.

properties.name: dirty
properties.description: Checked or mixed state differs from the initial state.

properties.name: touched
properties.description: Focus has left the control at least once.

methods.name: setChecked
methods.description: Programmatic state (no events); clears the mixed state unless given and clears an external custom error.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error; cleared when the user toggles.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial checked and mixed state and clear dirty/touched/submitted state.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove rendering, listeners, registration, and subscriptions.

events.name: aui-change
events.detail: { checked: boolean; value: string; validity: FieldValidity }

cssClasses.name: aui-checkbox__box
cssClasses.description: Positioning wrapper for the input and marks.

cssClasses.name: aui-checkbox__input
cssClasses.description: Native checkbox, restyled as the box.
